assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances, a cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable under current policy guidelines.
No reimbursement will be issued for this specific line item.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
Failure to submit an appeal within the designated period may result in the finalization of this denial decision.
